title: Meeting Rooms II
description:
Given an array of meeting time intervals `intervals`, where `intervals[i] = [start, end]` means a meeting runs from `start` up to (but not including) `end`, return the **minimum number of rooms** needed so that every meeting has a room to itself.

A room can be reused by a meeting that starts exactly when the previous one ends.

examples.explanation: [0,30] needs one room; the other two can share the second room.

hints: The answer is the largest number of meetings happening at the same moment.
Sort the start times and the end times separately, then sweep through them with two pointers.
